model: Bank FCFE at cost of equity (capital-retention residual income, engine route)

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E operating income, RMB m: H1 2026 actual 8,434.9 (+12.1% YoY; net interest income 7,389 +26% as NIM rose 1.39%->1.46% on a balance sheet +20% YoY) + H2 2026E 7,941 (H2 2025 actual 7,218.9 x 1.10). FY2025 actual 14,745.9. Operating income = net interest income + net fee and commission income + other non-interest income.
inputs.share_count_basis: FULLY DILUTED for the A-share convertible bond: 3,625.8m A+H ordinary shares on the register at 30 June 2026 (interim p.9 share capital RMB3,625,777k at RMB1 par) + 1,254.1m shares from RMB11,562.8m of unconverted BCQ Convertible Bonds at the latest conversion price RMB9.22 (interim 7.2.4 / 7.2.5). The A share (601963.SS) trades at RMB11.04, 120% of the conversion price, and has touched 12.42 in the last 52 weeks (the 130% forced-redemption trigger is 11.99); RMB1,437m converted in H1 2026 alone and the bond matures 22 March 2028. Conversion is the base expectation, so the 35% dilution is charged now; diluted EPS (KPI DilutedEPS, FY2025 1.20 vs basic 1.53) is the consistent per-share basis. Held flat thereafter: SBC-zero, no buyback, no other dilutive instrument. Perpetual bonds (RMB7.0bn) are not convertible and are treated as a senior claim via their coupon.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Bank: customer deposits (RMB627.2bn at 30 Jun 2026), interbank funding, central-bank borrowings and debt securities issued are operating funding; cash and central-bank balances are liquidity. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route. The convertible bond is handled on the share count (as converted), not as debt.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE on the diluted basis: PBT ~7,337 (44.8% of operating income; H1 4,081 actual + H2 ~3,256 at the H2 2025 41.1% margin) less ~13.5% leakage (income tax ~9%, NCI ~6.3%, perpetual coupon RMB324m, plus back the after-tax convertible interest ~RMB486m that disappears on conversion) = ~6,350 ordinary earnings, LESS CET1 retained to fund RWA growth of ~13.5% for the year (664.2bn FY2025 -> ~754bn FY2026E, x 9.5% target = ~8.5bn) => roughly -RMB0.9bn to -2bn. The bank is consuming more capital than it earns; its 30% cash payout is funded by the CET1 ratio drifting (9.88% FY2024 -> 8.53% FY2025 -> 8.56% H1 2026) and, prospectively, by the bond conversion. Reported OCF less capex (FY2025: 49,436 - 1,320) is deposit/interbank flow noise and is not used.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment scheme disclosed in the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports or the H1 2026 interim; basic/diluted EPS gap is entirely the convertible bond (interim note 13). House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate.
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Bank reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1724 at 2026-10-16T22:02Z, Yahoo Finance chart API. Triangulated against USDHKD=X 7.8479 / USDCNY=X 6.6768 = 1.1754 (same source, same day; 0.3% apart). The Shanghai A share (601963.SS) closed at RMB11.04 = HKD12.94, a ~58% A/H premium that is typical for small Chinese bank H shares, so the dual listing is not a parity check. Per-share values are per ordinary share and apply equally to A and H shares.
inputs.fy0: FY2026E (year ending 2026-12-31, unreported: H1 2026 actual + H2 estimate)
inputs.wacc_rationale: The discount rate is the COST OF EQUITY on CNY flows, not a WACC: deposits and debt are operating funding. Base 11.5% = CN 10y CGB ~1.8% + ~6.5% China equity risk premium x bank beta ~1.1 + ~2.5% for a regional city commercial bank (single-province Chongqing concentration, LGFV and infrastructure lending, top-10 customers 28.8% of net capital, CET1 only ~1pt above the 7.5% minimum). One point above the 10.5% used for 0998.HK (national joint-stock bank). Bull 11.0%, bear 12.5%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Immaterial (lease liabilities ~RMB0.2bn); depreciation and right-of-use costs sit inside operating expenses above PBT.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI (subsidiary village banks / leasing; RMB451m of FY2025 profit, ~6.3% of PBT) deducted in the leakage (cash_tax_rate_path), so flows are attributable to the Bank's shareholders.
inputs.notes: MODEL: bank -> residual income / FCFE at cost of equity per dcf-methods routing (bank row), run through the component engine exactly as 0998.HK: revenue = operating income; ebitda_margin_path = PRE-TAX margin after credit impairment (D&A 0, SBC 0, lease 0); cash_tax_rate_path = total leakage between PBT and earnings to ORDINARY shareholders on the as-converted basis (income tax + NCI + perpetual-bond coupon - after-tax convertible interest); capex_pct_path = CET1 capital retained to fund RWA growth at a 9.5% CET1 target (delta RWA x 9.5% / operating income); net_debt 0. With retention tied to RWA at a fixed ratio this is residual income on CET1 book. Terminal FCFE uses RWA growth equal to terminal growth. Diluted book value: ordinary equity 59.53bn (attributable 67.49bn less perpetual bonds 7.00bn and CB equity component 0.95bn) + ~12.5bn on conversion = ~72.0bn / 4,879.9m = RMB14.76 = HKD17.31 per share, so the H share trades at ~0.47x diluted book and ~5.4x FY2026E diluted earnings. The ShareholdersEquity column in the CSV includes the RMB8.0bn of perpetual + CB equity and overstates ordinary book.
inputs.rwa_note: RWA 717.9bn at 30 Jun 2026 (+8.1% in six months; +20.8% in FY2025, 549.7 -> 664.2bn). FY2026E end ~754bn assumes H2 +5%. CET1 capital 61.42bn (8.56%). Net loans 566.6bn, deposits 627.2bn, LDR 92.9%, NPL 1.11%, coverage 247%.

equity_bridge.item: Excess CET1 above 9.5% target after convertible conversion (FY2026E)
equity_bridge.note: CET1 61.42bn (H1 2026) + H2 retained ~1.7bn + conversion of RMB11.56bn nominal = ~74.7bn vs 9.5% x ~754bn RWA = ~71.6bn. Without the conversion CET1 would be ~8.4%, BELOW the target - the conversion is what restores headroom, which is why the share count is taken as converted.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: net_income_5yr_cagr (attributable profit FY2020-25); equity CAGR rejected because it is inflated by the 2021 A-share IPO (shares 3,127m -> 3,475m) and RMB7.0bn of perpetual bonds issued 2022-23, not compounding of retained earnings
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 9.4% vs revenue 2.7% and basic EPS 3.0%: divergence >30%. Book has grown through external capital (A-share IPO, perpetuals, convertible) and retained earnings while revenue stalled FY2021-24 on NIM compression (2.11% FY2017 -> 1.39% H1 2025).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF not meaningful for a bank (OCF is deposit/interbank flow). Revenue growth only re-accelerated in FY2025 (+11.2%) and H1 2026 (+12.1%) on balance-sheet growth of ~20%/yr.

base.growth_rationale: Operating income decelerates from ~11% (FY2026E) as policy-driven loan growth in the Chengdu-Chongqing region slows and the NIM gain from repricing deposits runs out; below RWA growth in FY2027-28 so revenue/RWA keeps drifting down.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin after impairment: FY2022 47.8%, FY2023 47.4%, FY2024 48.2%, FY2025 45.8%, FY2026E 44.8% (H1 48.4% vs 50.3% a year earlier; H2 seasonally ~41%). Credit impairment +14.8% YoY in H1 2026 against cost-to-income 25.4%; base holds 44.5%.
base.capex_rationale: CET1 retained at 9.5% on RWA growth of 11, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4.5, 4, 3.5, 3% from ~754bn FY2026E. FCFE is roughly nil in FY2027 and turns positive only as RWA growth slows; terminal ROE on CET1 ~8.8%.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~9% of PBT (FY2025 9.6%, H1 2026 7.7%: tax-exempt government and local-government bond income) + NCI ~6.3% + perpetual coupon RMB324m - after-tax convertible interest ~RMB486m; fixed-amount items shrink relative to PBT, effective tax drifts up modestly.
base.terminal_note: Gordon 1.03/0.085 = 12.1x terminal FCFE; cap at 12x roughly coincides.
base.narrative: Chongqing's policy-lending boom continues but slows; NIM holds ~1.45%, credit cost steady, and the convertible converts, restoring ~1.6pt of CET1 that growth then consumes. Earnings compound ~6-7% but most of it is retained, so per-share value is dominated by the terminal years.

bull.margin_rationale: NIM keeps recovering on deposit repricing (individual time deposits 52% of deposits); credit cost eases with NPL 1.11% and coverage 247%; margin returns to the FY2022-24 band.
bull.capex_rationale: RWA growth 10, 8, 7, 6, 5.5, 5, 4.5, 4, 3.5, 3.5% at a 9.5% CET1 target; revenue grows faster than RWA (operating leverage on capital).
bull.narrative: Regional growth plus NIM recovery: revenue outgrows RWA, ROE on CET1 rises above 11%, and the market re-rates the H share toward book.

bear.margin_rationale: LGFV/infrastructure and property credit cycle in a single-province book: credit cost up ~40bp in FY2028-29, NIM resumes compressing.
bear.capex_rationale: Policy-directed lending keeps RWA growing 12, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2% while revenue stalls: retention exceeds earnings for five years. In practice this is the scenario of a dividend cut or a discounted rights issue to the state shareholders; the flat diluted share count understates the damage.
bear.narrative: Credit cycle meets policy lending: the bank must keep growing the balance sheet for the region while margins fall, capital is consumed, and value accrues to borrowers and the state rather than minority H-share holders.

scenario_narratives.base: Growth slows from ~11% to 3% over a decade, pre-tax margin holds 44.5%, CET1 held at 9.5% after the convertible converts. FCFE is ~nil near-term and builds as RWA growth slows; terminal ROE on CET1 ~9% against an 11.5% cost of equity, so fair value is below diluted book.
scenario_narratives.bull: NIM recovery and benign credit lift margin to 47% and revenue outgrows RWA; ROE on CET1 rises to ~11%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Single-province credit cycle (LGFVs, property) with continued policy lending: earnings fall, capital is consumed for five years, and a dilutive raise or dividend cut follows.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 35% (above house default, same as 0998.HK): CET1 8.56% is only ~1pt above the 7.5% minimum and fell 1.35pt in FY2025 on 21% RWA growth; the dividend is already larger than FCFE; the book is concentrated in one province with heavy LGFV/infrastructure exposure and rising top-10 customer concentration (21.4% -> 28.8% of net capital in 18 months). Bull 20%: NIM has only just turned and policy lending caps returns to minorities.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A Chinese city commercial bank is worth the capital it can release to ordinary shareholders, discounted at a cost of equity. Earnings are real (ROE ~12% headline) but growth is policy-directed and capital-hungry, so most profit is retained; the 35% convertible dilution is charged up front because the A share trades 20% above the conversion price.
key_risks_to_valuation: Convertible does not convert (A share falls below RMB9.22 into the March 2028 maturity): no dilution but CET1 stays ~8.4% and a rights issue becomes likely
RWA growth stays near 15-20%: retention exceeds earnings and FCFE stays negative
LGFV / Chongqing property credit losses in a single-province book
NIM compression from LPR cuts resuming
Minority H-share holders rank behind state shareholders' policy objectives

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 7.07-8.81 HKD. A share 601963.SS and FX from the same source, same day.
data_sources.financials: 1963.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) and kpis; H1 2026 interim report (key indicators p.9, EPS note 13, convertible bond 7.2, perpetual bonds note 31, capital adequacy).
data_sources.qualitative: Interim and annual report management discussion; no Analysis JSON present at build time.
